title: rootless quadlet generation fails unable to find rootless dependency overriding rootful
body:
### Issue Description

see below

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. 
```
printf '%s\n%s\n' '[Container]' 'Image=test.com/test' | sudo tee /etc/containers/systemd/test1@.container
sudo ln -s --relative /etc/containers/systemd/test1@.container /etc/containers/systemd/test2@.container
sudo useradd -s /sbin/nologin test
sudo mkdir -p "/etc/containers/systemd/users/$(id -u test)"
sudo ln -s --relative /etc/containers/systemd/test1@.container "/etc/containers/systemd/users/$(id -u test)/test1@instance1.container"
sudo ln -s --relative /etc/containers/systemd/test2@.container "/etc/containers/systemd/users/$(id -u test)/test2@instance1.container"
sudo mkdir -p "/etc/containers/systemd/users/$(id -u test)/test2@instance1.container.d"
printf '%s\n%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Conflicts=test1@.container' | sudo tee "/etc/containers/systemd/users/$(id -u test)/test2@instance1.container.d/20-local.conf"
sudo -u test systemctl --user daemon-reload
```
2. `journalctl --unit "user@$(id -u test).service"`
3.
```
sudo ln -s --relative /etc/containers/systemd/test1@.container "/etc/containers/systemd/users/$(id -u test)/test1@.container"
sudo ln -sf --relative "/etc/containers/systemd/users/$(id -u test)/test1@.container" "/etc/containers/systemd/users/$(id -u test)/test1@instance1.container"
sudo -u test systemctl --user daemon-reload
```
4. `journalctl --unit "user@$(id -u test).service"`

### Describe the results you received

2. 
```
systemd[*]: quadlet-generator[*]: converting "test2@instance1.container": unable to translate dependency for test1@.container
```
4. no errors

### Describe the results you expected

2. no errors
4. no errors
